warnings: bank presentation: revenue is the filer's own Revenues total for every period

split ratio not applied: a 6-for-1 split effective 2021-12-31 is tagged, but no share count was re-filed on a new basis and the diluted counts filed before and after it (fiscal years and quarters) do not move by that ratio — the filings never changed share basis (a spin-off distribution ratio or a mis-tagged fact)

sbc: 1 derived quarter(s) (2019-12-31) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

capex: one caption per series — 2 fiscal year(s) (2017-12-31..2018-12-31) keep the tag the earlier years used, which the filer still files, instead of a higher-priority caption that appeared later (a change of definition, not of business)

capex: the filed caption changes (2019-12-31 PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets → PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment; 2020-12-31 PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment → PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets) — growth across a change is blank

capex: 2 derived quarter(s) (2020-09-30, 2022-12-31) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

debt_repaid: 4 derived quarter(s) (2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2021-09-30, 2021-12-31) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): da 2013-09-30, deferred_taxes 2013-09-30, ocf 2013-09-30, capex 2013-09-30, acquisitions 2016-12-31, acquisitions 2017-09-30, acquisitions 2024-12-31, purchases_investments 2013-09-30, sales_investments 2013-09-30, other_investing 2018-12-31, icf 2013-09-30, debt_issued 2014-12-31...
capex: no capital-expenditure figure is filed for 2 period(s) with operating cash flow (2020-09-30..2022-12-31); free cash flow and owner's earnings are blank there (capex is never read as zero)

restricted cash: in 30 period(s), 2019-03-31..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 30 period(s), 2019-03-31..2026-06-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

basis break (four quarters vs the fiscal year, >1% apart — the quarters and the year were filed on different bases: restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations; those quarters carry basis_break_quarterly and the growth cells across them are blank): da: 2016-12-31 (523,000,000 vs 515,000,000), 2017-12-31 (504,000,000 vs 487,000,000), 2019-12-31 (622,000,000 vs 633,000,000); sales_investments: 2016-12-31 (3,785,000,000 vs 220,000,000), 2017-12-31 (2,600,000,000 vs 253,000,000), 2019-12-31 (3,004,000,000 vs 3,946,000,000); dividends_paid: 2014-12-31 (1,557,000,000 vs 806,000,000), 2015-12-31 (195,000,000 vs 214,000,000), 2024-12-31 (1,350,000,000 vs 769,000,000)

growth across filing generations: 15 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): capex (2019-12-31, 2020-12-31); da (2016-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31); deferred_tax_assets (2016-12-31); long_term_debt (2018-12-31); other_lt_assets (2014-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2021-12-31, 2024-12-31); other_lt_liab (2024-12-31); other_opex (2016-12-31); short_term_debt (2018-12-31); total_debt (2018-12-31)
bank shape: interest income / expense, provision, noninterest lines, deposits and loans are shown; the non-bank interest lines are not

provision for credit losses: the filer tags no income-statement total — periods without one show the loans component + the off-balance-sheet component (both filed in that period; blank where either is absent), which can differ from the face line by other components (securities)
